record.question: Which sugar is present in DNA?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation: DNA contains 2-deoxyribose, a five-carbon (pentose) sugar. “Pentose” identifies the sugar class; deoxyribose is the specific pentose in DNA, unlike ribose in RNA.
